summary.text: John Salvesen, a Republican who goes by Bongo, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Georgia's 5th Congressional District to Nikema Williams.
He was also the party's nominee in 2024, when he lost to Williams.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience in the construction industry. Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Salvesen's birthplace as Burbank, California; in his 2024 Candidate Connection survey he described himself as originally from South Jersey and said he has lived in Atlanta since 1994.
It lists a graduate degree from Santa Monica College in 1989 and career experience in the construction industry.
Salvesen advanced from the May 21, 2024 Republican primary unopposed and lost the general election to Williams, 14.3% to 85.7%.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for the 5th District.
He received 9.8% of the vote to Nikema Williams' 90.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
